name: Volkswagen Group 6.0 L W12, naturally aspirated (Audi A8 L W12 code BSB, 2004-on; VW Phaeton BAN/BRN is the same engine)
summary: Two narrow-angle (15-degree) VR6 banks set 72 degrees apart on one seven-bearing crank whose pins are split by 12 degrees, so all twelve cylinders fire evenly every 60 degrees. It sounds like a smooth, slightly breathy V12 rather than anything exotic.

layout.note: 'W engine with a V angle of 15 deg and a bank angle of 72 deg': four rows of three cylinders, two cylinder heads.

bank_angle_deg.note: Angle between the two VR banks.

vr_angle_deg.note: Angle between the two rows of cylinders inside each bank.

cylinder_stagger.value: Bank 1 holds cylinders 1-6: one row 1-3-5, the other row 2-4-6, staggered along the engine. Bank 2 holds cylinders 7-12: rows 7-9-11 and 8-10-12. Cylinder axes do not pass through the crank axis: odd cylinders are offset -12.5 mm and even cylinders +12.5 mm (desaxe). Bank-to-bank offset along the crank 13 mm.
cylinder_stagger.note: Offsets +/-12.5 mm and bank offset 13 mm also in VW SSP 248. Which bank is left or right in the car is not stated in the text.

stroke_mm.note: VW SSP 248 (Phaeton BAN). Audi SSP 921403 prints 90.27 mm; Wikipedia prints 90.2 mm. With 84 mm bore, 90.2 mm gives the published 5,998 cc most closely (my arithmetic: 90.168 -> 5,996 cc, 90.27 -> 6,003 cc).

rod_length_mm.note: Not found; the Audi programme has a diagram labelled 'l - conrod length' with no number in the text.

compression_ratio.note: BSB. Wikipedia's Volkswagen Group engine list gives 10.7:1 for the family.

firing_order.note: Numbering: cylinders 1-6 in bank 1, 7-12 in bank 2 (see cylinder_stagger). Same order in VW SSP 248.

crank.value: Forged steel, seven main bearings, six crank pins 120 degrees apart, two connecting rods per pin. Each pin is split, the two halves offset 12 degrees ('split pin +12 deg'), because the 72-degree bank angle is 12 degrees more than the 60-degree interval. Because the cylinders are also offset from the crank axis, there is a 21.833-degree interval between the two crank pins on each plane.
crank.note: VW SSP 248 gives the rule: 72 deg bank angle - 60 deg spark gap = split pin +12 deg. Wikipedia quotes the crank mass as 21.2 kg.

valves_per_cylinder.note: DOHC per bank, roller rocker fingers, hydraulic lash adjustment, chain drive at the flywheel end.

intake_lift_mm.note: Not printed as a number. The valve-lift graph in Audi SSP 921403 has an axis to 12 mm; reading a peak from it would be a guess.

ivo_btdc.note: Timing measured at 1 mm valve lift and 0 mm valve clearance (Audi SSP 921403, p. 39). Both cams phase continuously: intake range 52 degrees crank, exhaust range 22 degrees crank. Value given as [fully advanced, fully retarded]. Opens 27 deg BTDC advanced, 25 deg ATDC retarded; same for odd and even cylinders.

ivc_abdc.note: Timing measured at 1 mm valve lift and 0 mm valve clearance (Audi SSP 921403, p. 39). Both cams phase continuously: intake range 52 degrees crank, exhaust range 22 degrees crank. Value given as [fully advanced, fully retarded]. Odd cylinders (1-3-5-7-9-11): closes 183 / 235 deg after TDC, i.e. 3 / 55 deg ABDC. Even cylinders (2-4-...-12): 188 / 240 deg after TDC, i.e. 8 / 60 deg ABDC. The odd/even difference compensates for the offset cylinders.

evo_bbdc.note: Timing measured at 1 mm valve lift and 0 mm valve clearance (Audi SSP 921403, p. 39). Both cams phase continuously: intake range 52 degrees crank, exhaust range 22 degrees crank. Value given as [fully advanced, fully retarded]. Odd cylinders: opens 235 / 213 deg before TDC, i.e. 55 / 33 deg BBDC. Even cylinders: 230 / 208 deg before TDC, i.e. 50 / 28 deg BBDC.

evc_atdc.note: Timing measured at 1 mm valve lift and 0 mm valve clearance (Audi SSP 921403, p. 39). Both cams phase continuously: intake range 52 degrees crank, exhaust range 22 degrees crank. Value given as [fully advanced, fully retarded]. Closes 20 deg BTDC advanced, 2 deg ATDC retarded; same for odd and even cylinders.

intake_duration_deg.note: At 1 mm lift, my subtraction from the angles above: odd cylinders 27+183 = 210; even cylinders 215.

exhaust_duration_deg.note: At 1 mm lift, my subtraction: odd cylinders 235-20 = 215; even cylinders 210.

redline_rpm.note: Not found. The Audi power graph runs to 7,000 rpm; peak power is at 6,200 rpm.

peak_power_kw.note: 450 hp, BSB (Audi A8 L). Wikipedia lists 331 kW for the same engine. Earlier Phaeton BAN / A8 AZC: 309 kW (420 PS) and 550 N·m (VW SSP 248); no rpm printed there.

peak_torque_nm.note: More than 90% of this is available at 1,800 rpm.

intake_type.value: plenum: one manifold per bank (double-flow), each with its own throttle body, air mass meter, air box and filter; magnesium, split into upper and lower sections; port injection
intake_type.note: VW SSP 248: 'each of the manifolds is coupled to a throttle valve control unit'.

header_type.value: two exhaust manifolds per cylinder head (one per row of three cylinders), each into its own close-coupled catalyst; the two pipes of each bank then merge at a main catalyst
header_type.note: So each bank is 3-into-1 twice, then 2-into-1.

exhaust_notes.value: Each bank has its own primary, intermediate and rear silencer. Two exhaust flaps (one per side) are closed at idle and light load and open above 5 km/h, 50% load and 2,500 rpm.

missing: peak valve lift as a number
peak rpm for the 309 kW Phaeton BAN tune

sources.what: Audi of America self-study programme 921403, 'The 6.0L W12 Engine in the Audi A8L' (2004), on an enthusiast file host. Manufacturer training document: technical data, crank drawing, valve timing table.
Volkswagen self-study programme 248, 'The W engine concept' (W8 and W12), hosted by The Drive. Manufacturer training document: specifications table, split-pin rule, intake and exhaust layout.
English Wikipedia list of Volkswagen Group petrol engines, WR12 section; used for the disagreeing stroke, compression and power figures.

name.note: Audi of America technical specifications, 2005 Audi A8 L W12 quattro (page also headed 2006). The research names the A8 L W12 code BSB; the sheet gives no engine code.

curb_kg.note: Quote: "Curb weight 4729 lbs. 2145 kg" (US). auto-data.net gives 1,995 kg (convention not stated).

tyre.note: US standard 19-inch: "Size 255 / 40", speed rating V; 275/35 R20 optional. Same size front and rear.

wheel_radius_m.note: Estimated (ours): rolling radius taken as 98% of the unloaded radius computed from the tyre size (rim diameter / 2 + section width x aspect ratio).

top_speed_kmh.note: Quote: "Top speed is electronically limited at 130 MPH (209 km/h)". European limit 250 km/h (auto-data.net, https://www.auto-data.net/en/audi-a8l-d3-4e-6.0-w12-450hp-quattro-tiptronic-4851).

driven.note: English Wikipedia, 'Audi A8' (read 2026-11-17), infobox layout: Longitudinal FF / F4 layout (quattro four-wheel drive). The W12 is a quattro, as its name says.
